name: Soul-Guide Lantern
reason: One-shot graveyard disruption that can instead be sacrificed to draw a card. Exiling all opponents’ graveyards consumes the Lantern; it is not reusable without recursion.

name: Scavenging Ooze
reason: Repeatable targeted graveyard exile on a creature, with a green mana cost per activation; useful pressure and life gain.

name: Rest in Peace
reason: Persistent graveyard suppression. Also shuts down your own graveyard, so excluded when your deck shows meaningful reliance.

name: Dauthi Voidwalker
reason: Suppresses opponents’ future graveyard deposits and can cash in an exiled card. Double black and vulnerability to creature removal matter.

name: Beast Within
reason: Instant-speed interaction for any permanent; trades the problem for a 3/3, so it remains useful beyond this matchup.

name: Generous Gift
reason: Broad instant-speed permanent removal with a 3/3 replacement. Answers enchantments without dedicating a slot solely to hate.

name: Feed the Swarm
reason: Black access to enchantment or creature removal; sorcery speed and life payment limit its emergency coverage.

name: Chaos Warp
reason: Red interaction for a resolved permanent, including enchantments; the replacement reveal can be dangerous.

name: Swords to Plowshares
reason: One-mana instant creature exile can remove a key attacker or creature engine; cannot stop noncreature engines.

name: Pongify
reason: One-mana instant creature removal with a 3/3 replacement; destruction does not beat indestructible.

name: Counterspell
reason: Stops a spell before it resolves; does not answer a resolved engine, triggered ability or activated ability.

name: Heroic Intervention
reason: Protects your board from many destruction and targeting effects; mass exile and sacrifice can bypass it.

name: Boros Charm
reason: Instant indestructibility against destruction wipes, with damage and double-strike modes for proactive turns.

name: Blasphemous Act
reason: Often a cheap creature-board reset when the table is crowded; also hits your own board and misses indestructible threats.

name: Austere Command
reason: Flexible mass removal that can spare parts of your board. Six mana and sorcery timing make it a reset, not fast emergency interaction.

name: Nevinyrral's Disk
reason: Colourless access to artifact, creature and enchantment sweeping; enters tapped, needs activation mana and is telegraphed. Can damage your own plan.
